title: release.json — what one release carries, versioned PER ARTEFACT
description: Emitted by tooling/ci/release-manifest.mjs --emit-release-json into the release directory BEFORE SHA256SUMS is written, so the integrity record names it. Graded by tooling/ci/assert-release-json.mjs. There is deliberately NO top-level version field: a cross-product version would renumber FullShot the day the app ships, and a store refuses a version that goes backwards.

unit.description: The product id this release is of — an apps/<id> directory or an extensions/Extension/*/tool.json id.

tag.description: The release tag <unit>-v<semver>, OR the <unit>-untagged-<short sha> sentinel the build-platforms release job already synthesises on a non-tag run. BOTH shapes are declared here because the emit and validate steps are deliberately NOT tag-gated: a schedule and a dispatch must exercise them, exactly as the staging step's own comment says of assert-app-versioning. A schema that accepted only the first would turn every scheduled run red, and gating the steps instead would leave them dead until the first real release — which is the failure mode this lane exists to remove.

releasedAt.description: The COMMIT's timestamp, not the run's: a re-run of the same commit must emit identical bytes, and a wall clock makes every re-run a different file that SHA256SUMS then disagrees with.

minSupported.description: The oldest version this release still serves. Until a declared field exists for it the lane passes the tag's own X.Y.Z, which is exactly true while no older build exists.

format.description: The LONGEST known extension, so `.tar.gz` stays whole rather than reading as `.gz`.

build.description: The app surface's build number. null on the extension surface, which has none.

size.description: Bytes. `size > 0` is a GUARD limb, not a schema one: this validator implements no `minimum`, and a keyword it does not implement is refused outright rather than silently skipped.

channels.description: The channel ids of tooling/channel-register.json this file can be submitted to. DERIVED, never typed. The schema cannot enumerate them — that would be a second copy of the register — so membership is a guard limb.
